<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/workspaces"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The workspaces of one organization that the caller can reach, one page at a time. Pages are 1-based. Sorted by name (default) or creation time. Requires membership on the organization: a caller who reaches none of its workspaces gets an empty page, not an error. `memberCount` is omitted unless `includeMemberCount=true`: counting resolves every member of every workspace on the page, which is slow for large organizations. An organization that is not migrated to the workspace model (or does not exist) is 409 `workspaces_not_available`.
